name: Liquid Distortion Text Hover
description: A WebGL text hover for React: the cursor smears a big word like wet paint, dragging the letters along a fading flowmap and splitting them into red, green and blue fringes that run along and across the stroke, with motion blur on fast moves. three.js, the word drawn to a canvas texture, live settings, paused off screen.

props.name: fontFamily
props.description: CSS font family; load the font on the page.

props.name: grain
props.description: A fine film grain over the background.

props.name: distortion
props.description: How far the flow drags the letters.

props.name: aberration
props.description: How far apart red, green and blue split.

props.name: dissipation
props.description: How long the smear lingers (closer to 1 = longer).

props.name: motionBlur
props.description: How much the last frame smears in on fast moves.

props.name: velocityScale
props.description: How hard the cursor's speed pushes.

props.name: padding
props.description: Space either side of the word, in CSS px.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height.
